MILESTONE PROOF OF ACHIEVEMENT - RESUBMISSION
This resubmission addresses all items raised in review.
Reviewer item -> status:
- Brief event summary -> published as repo README
- Repo organisation (PRs / issues) -> 29 PRs merged to main, 50 issues triaged and closed, v1.0-final tagged
- Mentorship and judging records -> judging process document, named 7-member panel, signed scorecard, dedicated in-person mentorship folder
- List of submitted projects + official winner announcement -> SUBMISSIONS.md (47 projects) + winners published on indiacodex.com
- Photos/videos indexation, live-event vs pre-event workshops separated -> evidence restructured by day and session, master index at top level, virtual workshops isolated in folder 03

A. OUTPUT: THREE VIRTUAL WORKSHOPS AND DEVELOPER ONBOARDING SESSIONS
Three pre-event virtual workshops facilitated by Maulesh Nagar, delivered live to registered participants ahead of the in-person event: Workshop 1 on wallet connection and basic transaction building, Workshop 2 on smart contracts and vesting contracts, Workshop 3 on building an NFT marketplace. All three were recorded and published publicly.
These three virtual sessions are distinct from the workshops and sessions delivered at the live event, which are documented separately under Output B.
Acceptance criteria: Three workshops delivered ahead of the main event, recordings publicly accessible, onboarding content covering wallet, smart contract and dApp development paths.
